messages:
mira.ops: Hey team — CloudMarket listing asked for final SOC2 attestation, latest pen-test summary, and a sanitized artifact bundle by EOW. Can we confirm owners?
alex.security: I can own the SOC artifacts and the pen summary. Will need redaction help from SI for API keys/logs.
jen.partnerships: I'll coordinate with the SI integrator and HW partner. Press/launch window is still targeted for next quarter so let's lock the evidence by Friday. :calendar:
samir.sis: SI can scrub logs and remove PII, but we need exact file list. Mira — do you have the artifact manifest?
mira.ops: Draft manifest attached here (v1). Will add owners. High level: soc_report.pdf, pen_summary.md, infra_diagram.pdf, fw_attestation.pdf, sample_config.tgz, sanitized_logs.tar.gz
alex.security: For pen_summary.md we need: findings list (low/med/high), remediation status, witness notes, dates, and scope. Also include the pentester contact for verification.
jen.partnerships: Noted. I pinged the SI lead @samir to ask for ETA on the scrub. Samir — can you give a day estimate to produce sanitized_logs and fw_attestation redactions?
samir.sis: ETA 48-72h for logs scrub + 24h for attestation packaging. We'll use the redaction checklist: remove IPs, keys, auth headers, and user identifiers.
mira.ops: Great. For uploads, we'll use presigned S3 links with 7-day expiry. Alex — can you confirm the ACL + encryption policy?
alex.security: Must be SSE-KMS, no public ACLs, and enable object‑lock for retention 30 days. I'll create the bucket policy and send a presign helper script.
deploy-bot: presign link created by mira.ops for sanitized_logs.tar.gz — https://presign.example.com/abcd1234 (expires in 7 days)
jen.partnerships: Perfect. Two additional asks from Marketplace: (1) an executive attestation letter (short) and (2) a contact for SOC questions. Mira, can you draft the attestation?
mira.ops: I'll draft and circulate for sign-off by EOD. Alex — are you comfortable as SOC contact?
alex.security: Yep, put my contact. Also request: include the scope matrix (what services/environments covered).
samir.sis: Also flagging hardware partner firmware attestation — partner legal needs the firmware hash + signing cert included in fw_attestation.pdf. I'll pull that and add to the package.
jen.partnerships: Timeline recap — owners: SOC/pen = alex, SI redaction & firmware = samir, uploads & attestation draft = mira, marketplace comms = jen. Target: artifacts uploaded + presigns by Friday 17:00 UTC. If any blocker, call it out today.
mira.ops: I'm setting a short checklist in the drive and will drop links here when ready.
alex.security: Quick note — redact anything mentioning customer names. Use placeholders. We'll run a small random sampling review before upload.
jen.partnerships: If all green, we'll align the press embargo to avoid drift: 48h after evidence accepted by marketplace. Will confirm exact cadence tomorrow.
mira.ops: thanks all — I'll post the drive checklist and the attestation draft in this thread when done. :thumbsup:
